request.description: Completes a request with the reply to the person. Erasure runs every module's eraser in order (answers, facts, documents and files, leads, consent withdrawals, account and sessions, contacts, identifiers and names) and records the counts; it is refused while a legal hold applies. Access rebuilds the export. DPDP data principal rights: `access` (a JSON export of the profile, contacts, account, consents, answers, facts, documents, leads, applications and lenders the file went to; built by the `privacy.requests` worker and kept 7 days), `correction` (`details` required; compliance applies it and replies), `erasure` (compliance completes it once no legal hold applies: open applications, loans disbursed in the last 5 years, active partner, lender or staff roles). One open request per kind; due within 30 days.
